caption: The sun comes out from behind a cloud over a beach, and the sand and sea brighten all at once.

sa.check: The sun comes out from behind a cloud over a beach.
The sand and sea brighten all at once.
It would dim again when the next cloud passes.

pc.expect: The whole scene brightens together and sharp shadows appear.
pc.fail: Only part brightens; or shadows stay soft in full sun; or the scene dims as the sun comes out.

pc.expect: The brightening follows the cloud's edge and holds while the sun is clear.
pc.fail: It flickers; or brightens then dims with the sun still out; or is instant with no cloud edge.

pc.expect: The cloud moves steadily and nothing on the beach moves with it.
pc.fail: The cloud jumps; or objects move; or shadows swing round.

pc.expect: Colours stay the same, only brighter.
pc.fail: The sand changes colour; or the sea changes colour; or the sky changes abruptly.

pc.expect: The beach's objects keep their number.
pc.fail: An object vanishes; or appears; or duplicates.
Items rearrange; or the shoreline moves; or the horizon changes.
